body:
Release 2026-08-09 shipped chrome-ext 0.1.13 + VS Code 0.1.2 as PR #1 (5 grouped commits on main; branch release/filemark-0.1.13 merged via rebase + deleted). Tags chrome-ext-v0.1.13 + vscode-v0.1.2 + GitHub Releases created (.vsix attached to the vscode one).
Contents (all in git): chrome-ext boot crash from a stale/moved folder handle -> guarded by buildFolderHandleMap + boot .catch (fs.ts, App.tsx); browser tab title now tracks the active file; modulePreload:false. mdx/chart: ChartErrorCard hugs content (dropped minHeight); native <details> renders children verbatim (empty-arrow fix). YouTube embeds via https helper. VS Code CSV/TSV preview + filemark.enableCsv. satl pass: extracted pickPreviewRenderer + named constants (CSV_EXTENSIONS, GITHUB_VIEW_MODE). Gates: 5 typechecks clean, 119 tests (60 chrome-ext + 28 vscode + 31 mdx).
Publish status: DONE = website deployed, Open VSX khanakia.filemark 0.1.2, VS Code Marketplace khanakia.khanakia-filemark 0.1.2 (manual upload; auto now enabled). OPEN ITEM = Chrome Web Store 0.1.13 NOT published — blocked by ITEM_NOT_UPDATABLE (prior submission stuck in review/ready-to-publish); the 0.1.13 zip is built (filemark.zip); resolve in CWS dashboard then `task cws:publish`. Offered-not-done: a combined `task release:vscode` (publish + publish-ovsx).
